summary.en: One week ago, a hostess named Atsuko Tonda was murdered in front of her house by an unknown assailant. She returned home early to pick up something she forgotten and surprised the intruder and a struggle broke out. The crime was discovered by Yumi and Naeko who saw the suspect spinning a hose ritualistically. The suspect threw the hose to obstruct Yumi before fleeing toward the Ramen Ogura shop, which the only customers were Yuna Shono, Sosuke Mizushina, and Osamu Nakanishi. Also, one of the victim expensive pair of earrings is missing.
